name: Dragon's Rage Breath
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing @actor.leveld6 @actor.flags.system.barbarian.instinct.dragon.damageType damage to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. The damage type matches your instinct's dragon breath, and this action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.
